name: Konoshiro Sayori
source:
A second year student and the student council accountant. She complains about Chinu's order to stop wearing underwear the most. She always speaks her mind and often gets angry. Your typical tsundere.

She works as a waitress at a local family restaurant. She has a crush on her senpai who works there.
